get.description: Reports that the process can serve requests. Does not probe dependencies.
Probes every configured dependency. Returns 503 when any dependency is down.

503.description: One or more dependencies are down.

post.description: Authenticated by the provider signature, not by a token. The payload is stored once and the payment is reconciled with the provider; the notification alone never moves money.
Authenticated by the carrier's own signature; applied once per carrier event id. An unknown tracking code is accepted and ignored, so the endpoint reveals nothing.

Runs the checkout for an anonymous cart: reserves the stock, places the order and takes the payment, in one call. A step that fails reverses what the earlier ones did, so a buyer is never charged for stock that was not held. The answer says what happened and, when it worked, the order it made.
post.summary: Buy what is in a cart

get.description: What became of a checkout. Whoever holds the id may read it, which is the same rule the cart follows: the id is unguessable and it is what a buyer has instead of an account.

post.description: Freezes the cart, reserves stock, creates the order at current prices and authorizes the payment. The answer is the checkout: completed, failed with a failure_code after compensating every step, or payment_pending.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
